subject: prd/prd-review
statement: When the author disposes findings, the reviewer's protocol shall bind blocking findings — applied, or declined with a recorded reason — record every disposition per finding, and treat a declined blocking finding as an automatic escalation.
rationale: the pushback signal is measurement (M1) and the conflict路 is the authority's, not a debate (— #D-2, #D-11)
fit_criterion: fixture dispositions all recorded; an unreasoned decline is invalid; a reasoned decline flips the path to escalate
